item.text:
## 2B.2 Research Note: Vladimir Putin, Russia, 2023

**Working judgment:** **Yes, overwhelmingly.** The 2023 record shows continued war expansion/coercion and only conditional diplomacy. I found no credible evidence that Putin accepted a genuine peaceful alternative when one was available.

### Evidence pointing yes

- **Title:** `ICC arrest warrants over deportation of Ukrainian children`  
  **Publisher:** International Criminal Court  
  **Date:** 17 Mar 2023  
  **URL:** [https://www.icc-cpi.int/situations/ukraine](https://www.icc-cpi.int/situations/ukraine)  
  **Claim-level summary:** The ICC announced arrest warrants for Putin and Maria Lvova-Belova over the unlawful deportation and transfer of Ukrainian children from occupied Ukraine. This is strong evidence of coercive wartime conduct tied to the broader war of choice in Ukraine.  
  **Question IDs:** `2B.2`

- **Title:** `Russia formalizes tactical nuclear deployment in Belarus`  
  **Publisher:** Reuters via ThePrint  
  **Date:** 25 May 2023  
  **URL:** [https://theprint.in/world/russia-signs-deal-to-deploy-tactical-nuclear-weapons-in-belarus-says-they-stay-under-its-control/1593879/](https://theprint.in/world/russia-signs-deal-to-deploy-tactical-nuclear-weapons-in-belarus-says-they-stay-under-its-control/1593879/)  
  **Claim-level summary:** Russia moved tactical nuclear weapons into Belarus and called it a countermeasure to Western escalation. In context, this is cross-border coercion and escalation beyond any narrow defensive necessity.  
  **Question IDs:** `2B.2`, `1B.1`, `1B.5`, `1B.6`

- **Title:** `Putin says nuclear warheads were delivered to Belarus as a warning to the West`  
  **Publisher:** Reuters via Investing.com  
  **Date:** 16 Jun 2023  
  **URL:** [https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/putin-says-russia-positions-nuclear-bombs-in-belarus-as-warning-to-west-3107500](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/putin-says-russia-positions-nuclear-bombs-in-belarus-as-warning-to-west-3107500)  
  **Claim-level summary:** Putin explicitly framed the Belarus nuclear deployment as a warning that the West could not inflict strategic defeat on Russia. That is direct coercive justification of the broader war effort rather than de-escalation.  
  **Question IDs:** `2B.2`, `1B.1`, `1B.2`, `1B.5`, `1B.6`

- **Title:** `Russia suspends participation in New START`  
  **Publisher:** Reuters  
  **Date:** 21 Feb 2023  
  **URL:** [https://gulfnews.com/world/europe/russias-putin-issues-new-nuclear-warnings-to-west-over-ukraine-1.1676971364764](https://gulfnews.com/world/europe/russias-putin-issues-new-nuclear-warnings-to-west-over-ukraine-1.1676971364764)  
  **Claim-level summary:** Putin suspended Russia’s participation in New START and threatened renewed nuclear testing. This is further evidence that he chose escalation and strategic coercion over restraint.  
  **Question IDs:** `2B.2`, `1B.4`, `1B.7`, `1B.8`

### Limited counterevidence

- **Title:** `Russia and China deepen strategic coordination, with talk of a political settlement`  
  **Publisher:** Kremlin  
  **Date:** 21 Mar 2023  
  **URL:** [https://special.kremlin.ru/supplement/5920](https://special.kremlin.ru/supplement/5920)  
  **Claim-level summary:** The joint statement welcomed China’s constructive role on Ukraine and said responsible dialogue is the path to a durable settlement. This is pro-diplomacy language, but it does not show compromise on substantive terms.  
  **Question IDs:** `2B.2`, `1B.8`

- **Title:** `Russia-Africa summit: Putin says Russia is ready for negotiations`  
  **Publisher:** Kremlin  
  **Date:** 28 Jul 2023  
  **URL:** [https://special.kremlin.ru/events/president/transcripts/71826](https://special.kremlin.ru/events/president/transcripts/71826)  
  **Claim-level summary:** Putin said Russia was ready for negotiations and that African peace proposals deserved attention. This is diplomatic signaling, but it was conditional and did not amount to compromise or de-escalation in practice.  
  **Question IDs:** `2B.2`, `1B.8`

### Search gap

I did **not** find reliable 2023 evidence that Putin accepted a credible peace deal, withdrew from occupied territory, or dialed back coercion when peaceful alternatives existed. The strongest “pro-diplomacy” items were conditional statements, not evidence of real compromise.

### Bottom line

**Yes.** In 2023 Putin continued and justified the Ukraine war with cross-border coercion and escalatory nuclear signaling. Diplomatic language existed, but it was subordinate to force and maximalist terms.
